title: How many Auto Loans may one customer hold at the same time?
content:
# How many Auto Loans may one customer hold at the same time?

This policy of the Auto Loans product category at PCB governs how many auto loans one customer may carry, and it is applied when a new auto loan application is to be recorded.

## Clauses

1. A customer may carry several Auto Loans at once.
2. **Portfolio limit.** Before a new application is recorded, the count of the customer's auto loans in applied, active or delinquent status must be below 3.
3. **Product limit.** The count of the customer's loans of the requested product in applied, active or delinquent status must be below that product's own limit on loans of the product per customer. Each of the six products (Used Vehicle, Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle, Auto Refinance, Lease Buyout, New Vehicle and Green Vehicle Loan) applies its own limit.
4. **Charge-off bar.** A customer with any auto loan in charged-off status cannot apply.
5. Paid-off and withdrawn loans do not count.

## Evidence

Each test is judged from PCB's records of the customer's auto loans and their statuses, as they stand before the application is recorded. The records are matched to the applicant by the customer reference; the customer's own description of their loans does not replace those records.

## The same clauses as a checklist

| Question on the customer's records | Required answer |
|---|---|
| How many of the customer's auto loans are applied, active or delinquent? | fewer than 3 |
| How many of those are of the product now requested? | fewer than that product's limit |
| Is any of the customer's auto loans charged off? | no |

## Hypothetical cases

| Customer's auto loans (hypothetical) | Counted loans | Outcome under this policy |
|---|---|---|
| 2 active, 1 paid off, 1 withdrawn; requests a product of which they hold none | 2 | the portfolio and product limits are met; no charge-off |
| 2 active, 1 applied | 3 | not below 3: the new application is not recorded |
| 1 delinquent, 1 charged off | 1 | the charge-off bar applies: the customer cannot apply |
| 1 active Lease Buyout Loan; requests another Lease Buyout Loan whose product limit is 1 | 1 of that product | not below the product limit: the new application is not recorded |

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "a paid-off loan still counts until the lien is released." **Correct basis:** paid-off loans do not count, whatever their lien stage.

**Wrong reading:** "a charged-off loan is closed, so it is ignored." **Correct basis:** any charged-off auto loan bars a new application outright.
